why: Both land on the same hedgehog (profit per active primary relationship) and the key regulator and decentralization facts, but Analysis 2 explicitly drops the eight-products goal and its decline register anticipates the bad-apples framing, regulatory growth limits and leadership churn. Analysis 1 is slightly better calibrated (it flags the deposit-mix assumption and states its confidence) and names the gaming pattern more sharply, but it only stops leading the investor story with the 'eight' goal rather than dropping it.
